source: AgileX PiPER quick-start manual, with joint6 and gripper corrected by measurement
notes: This is the abstract Piper envelope. It is what normalization maps onto
[-100, 100] and what teleop clamps the follower target to. It is deliberately
not any one arm's measured travel: it must be stable across arms and across
datasets, because two datasets normalized with different tables cannot be
The manual is accurate for joint1-joint5 (within 3.4 deg of measurement) but
states joint6 as +/-100 deg, which is wrong by about 72 deg per side; both
arms here reach +/-172. The manual's gripper figure of 70 mm is likewise
short of the 82.4 mm both grippers travel.
See left_arm_real.json and right_arm_real.json for the per-arm measurements.
